description: S462 review: a one-statement handler whose braceless `while` body is an if/else takes the statement path and runs the loop with the right arm (→ 3). Pre-fix the reroute looked only at a top-level if-with-else and this reached the text path.
rationale: §5.2.3: an inline block's statements SHALL run; an `else` binds to the nearest unmatched `if`.
